title: SAR interferometric coherence for change detection via openEO (Copernicus)
snippet: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem introduces SAR interferometric coherence processing for land deformation and change detection via the openEO platform. The service leverages Sentinel-1 SAR data to compute coherence maps that reveal ground deformation, subsidence, and structural changes. Available as a standardized openEO workflow, enabling researchers and analysts to detect infrastructure damage, landslides, and seismic deformation with consistent, reproducible processing across the Copernicus archive.
tag_reason: New SAR processing capability on Copernicus platform. Directly relevant to ground deformation, subsidence, and disaster damage assessment via InSAR coherence.
